profile.condition: Ischemic stroke (left hemisphere), 5 months ago. Right-hand weakness with mild flexor spasticity: starts every grip but can't finish it; ring and little finger weakest, thumb opposition limited. Home practice between weekly therapy visits.
profile.goals: Hold a cup with the right hand. Button a shirt. Carry a light shopping bag.
